column1: Save reusable Schema Compare configuration in an {{c1::.scmp}} file.
column2:
It stores source and target information, comparison options, and excluded object types.
Review source

column1: To skip formatting-only differences in Schema Compare, enable {{c1::Ignore whitespace}}.
column2:
Use the same comparison options across the team to keep drift checks consistent.
Review source

column1: When column position is irrelevant, enable {{c1::Ignore column order}} in Schema Compare.
column2:
Do not ignore the order if an application relies on column positions.
Review source

column1: SqlPackage's broad option for dropping target-only objects defaults to {{c1::DropObjectsNotInSource=False}}.
column2:
Object-specific drop options also exist, so inspect the plan instead of assuming that all extra objects are kept or dropped.
Review source

column1: SqlPackage's default guard against schema changes that can lose data is {{c1::BlockOnPossibleDataLoss=True}}.
column2:
This validation guard does not replace review of the generated deployment plan.
Review source

column1: Reverse-engineer a live database schema with SqlPackage {{c1::/Action:Extract}}.
column2:
Specify the source database connection and a separate output destination.
Review source

column1: During SqlPackage Extract, {{c1::/p:ExtractTarget=SchemaObjectType}} organizes SQL files by schema and object type.
column2:
This produces a script layout rather than the SqlProject output format.
Review source

column1: To extract both a .sqlproj and individual object definitions, use {{c1::/p:ExtractTarget=SqlProject}}.
column2:
This output also includes database options in the generated project.
Review source

column1: To preview changes that apply the project to production, use the live database as Schema Compare's {{c1::target}}.
column2:
Use the SQL project or its .dacpac as the source, then review the proposed updates.
Review source

column1: Install prerelease DacpacVerify globally with {{c1::dotnet tool install --global Microsoft.DacpacVerify --prerelease}}.
column2:
Compare artifacts with dacpacverify before.dacpac after.dacpac.
